description_en: Queries the details of an EIAM account
description_zh: 调用GetUser接口，查询一个EIAM账户详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi get-user --authorization 'Bearer AT8csE2seYxxxxxij' --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en:
The authorization information.
Format: Bearer ${access_token}.
Example: Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。
格式：Bearer ${access_token}。
示例：Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.name: authorization

accountExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the account. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
accountExpireTime.description_zh: 账户过期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
accountExpireTime.title_en: 账户过期时间, 毫秒时间
accountExpireTime.title_zh: 账户过期时间, 毫秒时间

createTime.description_en: The creation time of the account. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
createTime.description_zh: 账户创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
createTime.title_en: 创建时间, 毫秒时间
createTime.title_zh: 创建时间, 毫秒时间

customFields.description_en: The list of extended fields of the account

fieldName.description_en: The identifier of the extended field

fieldValue.description_en:
The field value.
Field values of any data type are returned as strings. For example, a Boolean value is returned as "true" or "false"
fieldValue.description_zh:
字段数据值。
任何数据类型的字段值均以字符串的方式返回。比如布尔类型返回的值为"true"或"false"

displayName.description_en: The display name of the account

emailVerified.description_en: Indicates whether the email address is verified. A value of true indicates that the email address has been verified by the user or set as verified by the administrator. A value of false indicates that the email address is not verified
emailVerified.description_zh: 邮箱是否已验证，true表示邮箱已经过用户的验证或被管理员设置为已验证，false表示未验证

groups.description_en: The list of groups to which the account belongs

lockExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the account lock. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
lockExpireTime.description_zh: 账户锁定过期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
lockExpireTime.title_en: 锁定过期时间, 毫秒时间
lockExpireTime.title_zh: 锁定过期时间, 毫秒时间

organizationalUnits.description_en: The list of organizations to which the account belongs

primary.description_en: Indicates whether the organization is the primary organization

passwordSet.description_en: Indicates whether the password is set

phoneNumber.description_en: The phone number of the account

phoneNumberVerified.description_en: Indicates whether the phone number is verified. A value of true indicates that the phone number has been verified by the user or set as verified by the administrator. A value of false indicates that the phone number is not verified
phoneNumberVerified.description_zh: 手机号是否已验证，true表示手机号已经过用户验证或被管理员设置为已验证，false表示未验证

phoneRegion.description_en: The phone region code. For example, the region code for the Chinese mainland is 86, without 00 or +
phoneRegion.description_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
phoneRegion.title_en: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
phoneRegion.title_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +

primaryOrganizationalUnitId.description_en: The ID of the primary organization to which the account belongs

registerTime.description_en: The registration time of the account. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
registerTime.description_zh: 账户注册时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

status.description_en:
The status of the account. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
status.description_zh:
账户状态，取值可选范围：
enabled - 启用中。
disabled - 禁用中
status.title_en: 账户状态, enabled:启用,disabled:禁用
status.title_zh: 账户状态, enabled:启用,disabled:禁用

updateTime.description_en: The last update time of the account. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
updateTime.description_zh: 账户最近一次更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
updateTime.title_en: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间
updateTime.title_zh: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间

userExternalId.description_en:
The external ID of the account. It is used to map external data to the IDaaS account. The default value is the IDaaS account ID.

Note: The external ID is unique within the same source type and source ID
userExternalId.description_zh:
账户外部ID，用于外部数据与IDaaS账户的数据关联映射，默认为IDaaS账户ID。

说明：外部ID在同一来源类型和来源ID下唯一

userSourceId.description_en:
The source ID of the account.

For self-managed accounts, the default value is the instance ID. For other types, the value corresponds to the enterprise ID of the respective source. For example, for accounts imported from DingTalk, the value is the corpId of the DingTalk enterprise
userSourceId.description_zh:
账户来源ID。

自建类型默认为实例ID，其他类型，分别对应不同来源的企业ID，比如钉钉来源对应钉钉企业的corpId

userSourceType.description_en:
The source type of the account. Valid values:
build_in: self-managed.
ding_talk: imported from DingTalk.
ad: imported from AD.
ldap: imported from LDAP
userSourceType.description_zh:
账户来源类型，取值可选范围：
build_in：自建。
ding_talk：钉钉导入。
ad：AD导入。
ldap：LDAP导入
userSourceType.title_en: 来源类型，build_in[自建],ding_talk[钉钉导入],ad[AD导入],ldap[LDAP导入]
userSourceType.title_zh: 来源类型，build_in[自建],ding_talk[钉钉导入],ad[AD导入],ldap[LDAP导入]
